no_cities: No cities registered. Add cities in the setup TUI (setup).
week_empty: No forecasts to compare this week (only days with a same-day 22:00 forecast are shown).
year_rank_high: Top {p}% most changeable of {n} days this year
year_rank_low: Bottom {p}% least changeable of {n} days this year
legend_year: Compared with other days of the year (median change of the 14 forecasts per day)
legend_month: Strip = 1 → 14 days before (left → right), compared with the same-day 22:00 forecast · weather and temps in each cell are the same-day 22:00 forecast
legend_week_score: Score = how close the n-days-before forecast was to the same-day 22:00 forecast (100 = same)
legend_week_weather: Weather change = difference in weather weight from the same day (0 = same)
legend_week_diff: Value = n-days-before forecast − same-day 22:00 forecast (+ means forecast higher)
day_sub: Same-day 22:00 forecast: {wx} · forecasts for this date from 14 days before to the same day
day_sub_no_d0: No same-day 22:00 forecast yet, showing forecast values instead of differences
day_note_weather: Weather change = |weather weight n days before − same day| / 5 (0 same ~ 1 clear↔heavy thunderstorm). Weather cannot be drawn as a value, so its change is shown
day_note_diff: Value = n-days-before forecast − same-day forecast (same day = 0)
preset_too_long: With {bin} steps you can view up to {days} days
graph_note: One point = {bin} ({how}) · Wheel: zoom · Shift+wheel or drag: move · times are local to each city · even days are dashed
graph_how_day: within the span: high = max, low = min, rainfall = total, rain chance and wind = max, visibility = min (same rules as the day view)
graph_how_days: average of daily values (average high / low), rainfall is total
bin_max: With {bin} steps you can view up to {days} days. Use a larger step to see more.
err.range_too_long: The period must be {detail} days or less
